wxdragon-sys 0.9.22 (crates.io, MIT OR Apache-2.0), vendored for BrailleCraft.

Changes, all in cpp/include/core/wxd_print.h and cpp/src/print.cpp, marked "Added for BrailleCraft":
- wxd_FontEnumerator_GetFacenames: the system's font face names (wxFontEnumerator), one per line.
- wxd_PrintData_Assign: copy one print data object into another.
- wxd_PrintData_SetPrinterName / wxd_PrintData_GetPrinterName: the chosen printer.
- wxd_PrintData_SetPaperSizeTenthsMM / wxd_PrintData_GetPaperSizeTenthsMM: the paper, by its size (a standard
  paper when one has that size, else a custom size).
- wxd_PrintData_SetLandscape / wxd_PrintData_IsLandscape: the orientation.
- wxd_PrintData_SetNoCopies: the copy count.
- wxd_Printer_GetLastError: whether the last print was cancelled or failed.
- wxd_Printout_GetPaperRectPixels: the paper's rectangle in printer pixels, so margins are measured from the paper's
  edge.

Also added, in cpp/include/core/wxd_reader_static_text.h and cpp/src/reader_static_text.cpp (listed in
cpp/CMakeLists.txt and included from cpp/include/wxdragon.h):
- WxdReaderStaticText: a wxStaticText that accepts focus, and so is reached by Tab, on Windows while the system's
  screen reader flag (SPI_GETSCREENREADER) is on and the text is not empty; dialog resources name it with
  subclass="WxdReaderStaticText".
- wxd_ReaderStaticText_Registered: whether that class is registered; called once at start-up so the class is kept.

Also added, in cpp/include/core/wxd_cursor_locator.h and cpp/src/cursor_locator.cpp (listed in cpp/CMakeLists.txt
and included from cpp/include/wxdragon.h):
- wxd_TextCtrl_ShowCursorLocator: the Cursor Locator over a multi-line text control, a rectangle closing in on the
  caret, drawn with four borderless popup windows in the window text colour.

Also added, in cpp/include/core/wxd_space_after.h, cpp/src/space_after.cpp and cpp/src/space_after_osx.mm
(macOS only; listed in cpp/CMakeLists.txt and included from cpp/include/wxdragon.h):
- wxd_TextCtrl_SetSpaceAfter: empty space after a line of a multi-line text control, with no text in it: the
  text view's pixels-below-lines tag on GTK, its paragraph spacing on macOS, wxWidgets' paragraph spacing on
  Windows.
  cpp/CMakeLists.txt adds the GTK 3 include directories (pkg-config gtk+-3.0) on Linux for it.

Also added, in cpp/include/core/wxd_line_gutter.h and cpp/src/line_gutter.cpp (listed in cpp/CMakeLists.txt and
included from cpp/include/wxdragon.h):
- wxd_LineGutter_Create and wxd_LineGutter_SetMarks: a narrow drawn column beside a multi-line text control showing
  labels (line numbers) at the height of given text positions, repainted when the control scrolls or is resized.

Also added, in cpp/include/core/wxd_doc_editor.h, cpp/src/doc_editor.cpp, cpp/src/doc_editor_internal.h,
cpp/src/doc_editor_gtk.cpp (Linux), cpp/src/doc_editor_msw.cpp (Windows) and cpp/src/doc_editor_osx.mm (macOS; all
listed in cpp/CMakeLists.txt and the header included from cpp/include/wxdragon.h):
- wxd_DocEditor_Create and the other wxd_DocEditor_ functions: the document editing window, drawn by the program (a
  wxScrolledCanvas): rows of text and page break rows (a line across), the selection, the system caret, a line
  number column, the Cursor Locator drawn in the window; keys, typed characters (and keys let go), clicks and focus
  handed to the program through callbacks; one row per wheel notch; the scroll box takes effect when let go.
- Its text for screen readers: on Linux an ATK object with the text interface given out through the widget class's
  get_accessible; on Windows a UI Automation provider (element, Text pattern, text ranges) answering WM_GETOBJECT,
  with UiaReturnRawElementProvider and the text changed and selection changed events, while
  wxd_DocEditor_SetSupportUIAutomation is on; on macOS the accessibility text area methods added to the window's view
  by a subclass made at run time, with the value changed and selected text changed notifications.
- build.rs links uiautomationcore on Windows for it.

The Rust bindings are generated from the header when the crate builds, so no Rust file changed.
The workspace Cargo.toml uses this copy through [patch.crates-io].
